notes.title: Spanish Translation Added and French Translation Updated!
notes.content:
After many months of hard work, the Spanish translation has been added to the game! This includes menus and in-game dialogue. (Everything you need).

The French translation has also been updated and many small errors have been fixed.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
I just pushed a small update which takes care of three things:

[list]
    [*]Volume can now be adjusted to various levels (high, medium, low, off) instead of just on/off.
    [*]Two people reported graphical glitches on PC (a green screen whenever clicking through dialogue). This is hopefully fixed now.
    [*]The back button in the Live Lily screen now works.
[/list]

Thanks for being patient! :D

notes.title: Post-Release Update!
notes.content:
First off, I just want to say THANKS! to everyone who has purchased the game and taken the time to give me feedback! This has been such a crazy fun experience so far.

It's been about an hour since release and I've already started work on a small update. I've gotten a single report of some weird graphical glitches. The update I'm working on should address this. I've also added variable volume for the next update instead of just on/off.

If you have any feedback or suggestions, please feel free to reach out to me. I'm always active on Twitter. (@LolicOnion)
